text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field is '---', which contradicts note N3 that specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth and no stated stage for the hardness requirement. The designer must update the title block to reflect the required heat treatment or ensure the note clearly defines when it applies.","recommended_correction":"Replace '---' in the heat_treatment title-block field with the case-hardening specification, or revise note N3 to explicitly state the manufacturing stage at which the heat treatment applies."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"20.1±0.02"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D9 has a tolerance band of 0.04 mm (≤ 0.1 mm) on a part that receives IZBP plating per the title block, yet there is no indication that the plating thickness is allowed for. Without accounting for the coating build-up, the finished part will be out of tolerance and may not assemble correctly.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate dimension and tolerance of D9 to allow for the specified IZBP plating thickness, or add a note stating the dimension applies after plating."}]}
